The '''Kyolorian snake-god''' was a [[Deity/Legends|deity]]<ref name="Abduction" /> originating in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Kyolorian [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-[[Deity/Legends|god]]|system=[[Kyoloria system/Legends|Kyoloria system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Kyoloria system/Legends|Kyoloria system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an exquisitely decorated [[Galinolo]] [[Subservient Mark VII Attendant Droid]] served [[Braig Farool]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administrator]] of [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]], in the company's [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center|administration center]] on the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. The features of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], whose skin was covered by a thin layer of [[Color/Legends|iridescent]] scales, were formed in the likeness of the Kyolorian [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-god.<ref name="Abduction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kyolorian snake-god was introduced in ''[[The Abduction]]'', a [[1992]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Chuck Truett]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Abduction" />
